title: DoubtLess: Training-Free Contrastive Decoding for Efficient Reasoning
title_zh: DoubtLess：无需训练的对比式解码，助力高效推理

paragraphs.en: Reasoning models achieve strong performance through long chains of thought (CoT), but often spend more tokens than needed to solve a problem. Existing ways to shorten the CoT require additional training for each model, add a fixed steering vector to the model’s hidden states, or use decoding heuristics such as stopping early or banning words like wait , which can reduce accuracy. We propose DoubtLess, a training-free decoding method in which a much smaller reasoning model steers the large one towards brevity. The small model reads the large model’s CoT so far twice, once prompted to be brief (the brief thinker ) and once prompted to be verbose (the verbose thinker ), and the difference between its two logit vectors, scaled by a strength, is added to the large model’s logits at every step of the CoT. On seven benchmarks of competition mathematics, graduate-level science and competitive programming, DoubtLess shortens the CoT of Qwen3-32B by 31% with unchanged accuracy, outperforming five inference-time baselines. We also show that DoubtLess reduces thinking tokens per turn by 20% in a self-debugging coding agent with unchanged task performance. It also generalizes to two other model families with unchanged accuracy. When combined with training-based compression, it further shortens the CoT of a model already trained for brevity. Ablations and behavioral analysis show that DoubtLess reduces repeated checking, with most token savings coming after the correct answer first appears in the CoT. Our code is available at https://github.com/leoluolol/DoubtLess .
paragraphs.zh: 推理模型通过长链思考（CoT）实现了强大的性能，但解决问题时往往消耗了超出必要的 token。 现有的缩短 CoT 的方法需要为每个模型进行额外训练、向模型的隐藏状态添加固定的引导向量，或使用诸如提前停止或禁止使用“wait”等词语的解码启发式方法，而这些方法可能会降低准确性。 我们提出了 DoubtLess，一种无需训练的解码方法，其中一个小得多的推理模型会引导大模型生成更简洁的输出。 小模型会两次读取大模型当前的 CoT：一次是提示其保持简洁（“简洁思考者”），另一次是提示其详尽阐述（“冗长思考者”）；然后将其两次逻辑向量之差乘以强度系数，并在 CoT 的每一步中加到大模型的逻辑向量上。 在七项竞赛数学、研究生级科学和编程竞赛基准测试中，DoubtLess 使 Qwen3-32B 的 CoT 缩短了 31%，同时保持准确性不变，并优于五种推理时的基线方法。 我们还发现，DoubtLess 在一个自我调试的编码智能体中，将每次轮次的思考 token 减少了 20%，而任务性能保持不变。 该方法还能推广到另外两个模型家族，且准确性不受影响。 当与基于训练的压缩方法结合使用时，它还能进一步缩短一个已针对简洁性进行训练的大模型的 CoT。 消融实验和行为分析表明，DoubtLess 减少了重复检查，而大部分 token 的节省发生在正确答案首次出现在 CoT 之后。 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/leoluolol/DoubtLess 获取。

paragraphs.en: Reasoning models such as Qwen3 and DeepSeek-R1 write a chain of thought (CoT) between the tokens <think> and </think> before they answer. On a hard problem the CoT holds most of the output, and a large part of it re-derives and re-verifies a result the model has already reached ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Sui et al., 2025 ) . Under plain decoding, that is, sampling from the model as released, a correct run of Qwen3-32B writes 32–69% of its CoT after the correct answer first appears (Figure 1 ). Not all of this checking is redundant. A check made while the model works, or a first check of its answer, can catch an error, but repeating a check that has already been made adds tokens without adding information. A method that shortens the CoT should remove the redundant checks and keep the necessary ones.
paragraphs.zh: 像 Qwen3 和 DeepSeek-R1 这样的推理模型在回答问题前，会在 <think> 和 </think> 这些标记之间生成一条思维链（CoT）。 对于难题，思维链占据了输出的大部分内容，其中很大一部分会重新推导并验证模型已经得出的结果（Chen et al., 2024；Sui et al., 2025）。 在普通解码方式下，即从已发布的模型中进行采样，Qwen3-32B 在一次正确运行中，会在正确答案首次出现后生成其思维链的 32%–69%（图 1）。 这些检查并非全部冗余。 在模型运行过程中进行的检查，或对其答案的首次检查，可以发现错误；但重复已经执行过的检查只会增加标记量，而不会提供额外信息。 一种能够缩短思维链的方法，应当去除冗余的检查步骤，同时保留必要的检查。

paragraphs.en: Existing methods for shortening the CoT fall into two groups. Training-based methods add a length penalty or a token limit to reinforcement learning ( Aggarwal and Welleck, 2025 ; Hou et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2025 ) or fine-tune on short traces ( Chen et al., 2024 ) . Both change the weights, so every new model needs another round of training. Inference-time methods ask for brevity in the prompt ( Renze and Guven, 2024 ; Han et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) , block words such as wait that open another round of checking ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , end the CoT once an answer looks ready or a token budget is spent ( Yang et al., 2025b ; Song et al., 2026 ; Muennighoff et al., 2025 ) , or add a fixed steering vector to the model’s hidden states ( Azizi et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2025 ) . Prompting depends on how closely the model follows the instruction. Keyword bans suppress the same words across contexts, activation steering adds the same vector to the hidden states at every step, and early stopping ends the CoT once its criterion is met. These controls can shorten useful reasoning as well as redundant checks.
paragraphs.zh: 现有缩短 CoT 的方法可分为两类。 基于训练的方法会在强化学习中加入长度惩罚或令牌限制（Aggarwal and Welleck, 2025；Hou et al., 2025；Luo et al., 2025），或在短轨迹上进行微调（Chen et al., 2024）。 这两种方法都会改变权重，因此每个新模型都需要重新训练。 推理时方法则要求提示更简洁（Renze and Guven, 2024；Han et al., 2025；Xu et al., 2025），阻止“wait”这类会开启新一轮检查的词语（Wang et al., 2025），在答案看似完整或令牌预算用尽时终止 CoT（Yang et al., 2025b；Song et al., 2026；Muennighoff et al., 2025），或在模型的隐藏状态中加入固定的引导向量（Azizi et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2025；Lin et al., 2025）。 提示方法的效果取决于模型对指令的遵循程度。 关键词禁令会在不同上下文中抑制相同词语的出现，激活引导会在每一步向隐藏状态中加入相同的向量，而提前终止则会在 CoT 满足特定标准时结束推理过程。 这些控制手段既可能缩短有用的推理过程，也可能中断冗余的检查步骤。

paragraphs.en: In this paper we propose DoubtLess, a training-free decoding method that steers a reasoning model with a much smaller reasoning model that shares its tokenizer (Figure 2 ). At every step of the CoT, the small model reads the text the large model has written so far twice: once after an instruction to go straight to the answer, as the brief thinker , and once after an instruction to double-check every step, as the verbose thinker . The difference between the two logit vectors, multiplied by a strength α \alpha , is added to the large model’s logits. The small model only suggests a direction, towards what the brief thinker would write next and away from what the verbose thinker would. The large model still decides which tokens are possible, and the CoT can end only where the large model itself would consider ending it (Section 2 ). Inspired by DExperts ( Liu et al., 2021 ) , DoubtLess steers the large model through the vocabulary it shares with a small model, but needs no trained expert, since both sides of the contrast come from one off-the-shelf small model under two instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 DoubtLess——一种无需训练的解码方法，它通过一个共享词元化器的、规模小得多的推理模型来引导大型推理模型（图 2）。 在每个 CoT 步骤中，小型模型都会两次读取大型模型迄今生成的文本：第一次是在收到直接给出答案的指令后，作为“简洁思考者”；第二次是在收到检查每一步骤的指令后，作为“详尽思考者”。 两个 logits 向量之间的差值乘以强度系数 α \alpha，然后加到大型模型的 logits 上。 小型模型仅提出方向性建议：引导模型朝向“简洁思考者”会书写的下一内容发展，同时远离“详尽思考者”会书写的方向。 大型模型仍然决定哪些词元是可行的，而 CoT 只能在大型模型自身认为可以结束的位置终止（第 2 节）。 DoubtLess 的灵感来自 DExperts（Liu 等人，2021），它通过大型模型与小型模型共享的词汇表来引导大型模型，但无需任何训练好的专家模型，因为对比的两方都源于同一个现成的小型模型在两种不同指令下的输出。

paragraphs.en: Two properties set DoubtLess apart from prompting, keyword bans, activation steering and early stopping. First, the contrast is dynamic. It is recomputed from the current context at every step, so a word such as But is pushed down after an answer and left almost untouched before it, whereas a keyword ban blocks it everywhere and activation steering applies one fixed vector at every step. Second, the brief and verbose thinkers disagree most after the correct answer first appears in the CoT, where the brief thinker would wrap up and the verbose one would check again (Section 5.1 ). Most of the removed tokens come from this later checking.
paragraphs.zh: 有两个特性使 DoubtLess 与其他提示方法区别开来：关键词禁令、激活引导和提前停止。 首先，这种对比是动态的。 它在每一步都会根据当前上下文重新计算，因此像“But”这样的词在答案出现后会被抑制，而在答案之前则几乎不受影响；相比之下，关键词禁令会在任何地方阻止它，而激活引导则在每一步应用一个固定的向量。 其次，简洁型和冗长型思考者在 CoT 中首次出现正确答案后分歧最大：此时简洁型思考者会结束推理，而冗长型思考者则会再次检查（第 5.1 节）。 被移除的标记大多来自这种后期的检查过程。

paragraphs.en: We compare DoubtLess with five inference-time baselines on seven benchmarks of competition mathematics, graduate-level science and competitive programming, with the model’s recommended sampling settings and three seeds per problem. With Qwen3-32B steered by Qwen3-0.6B, DoubtLess removes 31% of the thinking tokens with unchanged accuracy, more than any baseline. It keeps accuracy where the baselines lose it. On AIME 2025, for example, blocking the words that open another round of checking costs 14 points, while DoubtLess costs none. DoubtLess also extends to an agent, a model trained for brevity and two other model families. It reduces thinking per turn by 20% in a self-debugging coding agent and further shortens the CoT of a model trained for brevity with LACONIC ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . On AIME 2025 and AMC 2023, it removes 25% and 40% of the thinking of EXAONE-4.0 and Granite-4.2, each steered by a small model of its own family, where a concise prompt removes 8% and 14%. Finally, our ablations show that the strength sets how much is removed, that a negative strength lengthens the CoT instead, and that the shortening depends on which tokens the small model pushes down.

paragraphs.en: We compare DoubtLess with plain decoding and with five training-free methods of the kinds in Section 1 : a prompt, a ban on words, two rules that end the CoT early and a steering vector. Concise prompt asks the large model itself to be brief: the brief thinker’s sentence, which tells the model to go straight to the answer and not to re-derive or re-verify anything, is appended to the large model’s own instruction. How much it removes depends on how closely the large model follows the instruction. NoWait ( Wang et al., 2025 ) blocks 17 words that open another round of checking ( wait , alternatively , hmm , but , however and others) throughout the generation, by adding a bias of − 100 -100 to the logits of their single-token forms (89 token ids). DEER ( Yang et al., 2025b ) ends the CoT early. At each of the first ten occurrences of Wait it induces a trial answer, ends the CoT if the geometric mean of the trial’s token probabilities exceeds 0.95 0.95 , and otherwise discards the trial and lets the CoT continue. It also ends the CoT once it reaches 0.8 of the budget. A DEER run is a prefix of the plain-decoding run followed by </think> and a freshly sampled answer, so we evaluate it on the stored plain-decoding runs with the same engine, sampler and seeds (Appendix D ). ThinkBrake ( Song et al., 2026 ) ends the CoT at a sentence boundary once </think> comes within a logit margin of 0.1 0.1 of the most likely token, read after a single newline as in the authors’ code, and is evaluated like DEER (Appendix D ). ASC ( Azizi et al., 2026 ) adds a fixed steering vector to the large model’s hidden states after one layer, at every decoding step. We use the training-free version in the authors’ released code, in which the vector is the mean difference between the hidden states at the last token of a verbose and of a concise CoT, here Qwen3-32B’s own CoTs on 100 MATH-500 problems ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ; Lightman et al., 2024 ) under its plain instruction and under the brief thinker’s sentence. It is added after layer 57 of 64, the layer the authors use for the 64-layer QwQ-32B, with the strength chosen on AIME 2026 ( Mathematical Association of America, 2026 ) as for DoubtLess (Appendix D ). We also decode the random-target control of Section 6.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 DoubtLess 与单纯解码以及第 1 节中提到的五种无需训练的方法进行了比较：一个提示词、一项词语禁令、两条提前终止 CoT 的规则，以及一个引导向量。 简洁提示词要求大型模型本身保持简短：将“简洁思考者”的句子附加到大型模型自身的指令中，该句子指示模型直接给出答案，不要重新推导或验证任何内容。 它能消除多少内容取决于大型模型对指令的遵循程度。 NoWait（Wang 等，2025）通过在生成过程中阻止 17 个会开启新一轮检查的词语（如 wait、alternatively、hmm、but、however 等），在它们的单词形式（89 个词元 ID）的 logits 上添加 −100 的偏置。 DEER（Yang 等，2025b）会提前终止 CoT。 在每次出现前十个 Wait 时，它会生成一个试答；如果试答的词元概率几何平均值超过 0.95，则终止 CoT；否则丢弃该试答并让 CoT 继续执行。 当 CoT 达到预算的 0.8 时，它也会终止。 一次 DEER 运行包括单纯解码运行的前缀、随后添加的 参考答案 以及一个全新采样的答案，因此我们使用相同的引擎、采样器和种子（附录 D）在已存储的单纯解码运行上进行评估。 ThinkBrake（Song 等，2026）会在 参考答案 的词元 logit 值与最可能词元的 logit 值之差达到 0.1 的阈值时，在句子边界处终止 CoT；该词元按作者代码中的方式读取，即仅读取一个换行符后的内容，其评估方式与 DEER 相同（附录 D）。 ASC（Azizi 等，2026）在每个解码步骤中，都将一个固定的引导向量添加到大型模型经过一层处理后的隐藏状态中。 我们使用的是作者发布代码中的无需训练版本，其中该向量是冗长 CoT 和简洁 CoT 最后一个词元处隐藏状态的平均差异；此处使用的是 Qwen3-32B 在 100 个 MATH-500 问题（Hendrycks 等，2021；Lightman 等，2024）上，分别在其原始指令和“简洁思考者”句子下的 CoT。 该向量被添加在第 64 层的第 57 层之后——这是作者用于 64 层 QwQ-32B 的层；其强度是在 AIME 2026（美国数学协会，2026）上根据 DoubtLess 的方法选择的（附录 D）。 我们还对第 6.1 节中的随机目标控制进行了解码。

paragraphs.en: Across the seven benchmarks, DoubtLess removes 31% of the thinking tokens with unchanged accuracy (Table 1 , overall column; intervals in Table 7 ). This is the largest reduction among the six methods (Figure 4 a). The concise prompt comes closest, but DoubtLess removes more than it on six of the seven benchmarks. The other baselines remove less, and ThinkBrake and NoWait lose more accuracy than DoubtLess.
paragraphs.zh: 在七项基准测试中，DoubtLess 在保持准确率不变的情况下，去除了 31% 的思考标记（表 1，总体列；区间见表 7）。 这是六种方法中幅度最大的削减（图 4a）。 简洁提示的表现最为接近，但在七项基准测试中的六项上，DoubtLess 的削减幅度更大。 其他基线方法的削减幅度更小，而 ThinkBrake 和 NoWait 的准确率损失比 DoubtLess 更多。

paragraphs.en: We extend DoubtLess to a self-debugging coding agent on HumanEval+ ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) , which writes a program, runs the tests and gets one repair turn on failure. DoubtLess is applied inside the CoT of every turn (Appendix J ). Over the 164 problems, the agent thinks 20% less per turn and improves its pass rate by 2.0 points over plain decoding (Table 1 , Agent column). DEER removes 41% and improves the pass rate by 4.5 points. It ends the CoT once 80% of the turn’s thinking budget is spent, which leaves room for a program in every turn, whereas under plain decoding 16–20% of the turns use the whole budget for thinking and write no program (Appendix J ). NoWait and ThinkBrake remove more but lower the pass rate, ThinkBrake by 6.9 points.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 DoubtLess 扩展为一个可在 HumanEval+（Chen 等人，2021；Liu 等人，2023）上自我调试的编码智能体：该智能体会编写程序、运行测试，并在失败时获得一次修复机会。 DoubtLess 被应用于每一轮 CoT 推理过程中（附录 J）。 在 164 个问题中，该智能体每轮的思考量减少了 20%，与单纯解码相比，其通过率提升了 2.0 个百分点（表 1，“智能体”列）。 DEER 减少了 41% 的思考量，并将通过率提升了 4.5 个百分点。 当一轮推理的思考预算消耗到 80% 时，CoT 就会终止，这为每一轮都留出了编写程序的空间；而采用单纯解码时，有 16–20% 的轮次会耗尽全部思考预算而不编写任何程序（附录 J）。 NoWait 和 ThinkBrake 虽然减少了更多思考量，但降低了通过率，其中 ThinkBrake 导致通过率下降了 6.9 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: Training-based methods shorten the CoT by changing the weights, while DoubtLess acts only at decoding time, so the two can be combined. We test this on a Qwen3-32B checkpoint fine-tuned with LACONIC ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , which adds an adaptive length penalty to the task reward during reinforcement learning, and steer it with Qwen3-0.6B at α = 5 \alpha{=}5 . Across mathematics, science and coding-agent benchmarks, DoubtLess further reduces thinking tokens by 29–52% with unchanged task performance (Table 2 ). DoubtLess thus complements training-based compression and applies to an already compressed model without further training.
paragraphs.zh: 基于训练的方法通过调整权重来缩短 CoT，而 DoubtLess 仅在解码阶段发挥作用，因此两者可以结合使用。 我们在一个经过 LACONIC（Liu et al., 2026）微调的 Qwen3-32B 检查点上进行测试，该方法在强化学习期间为任务奖励添加了自适应长度惩罚，并通过 α = 5 \alpha{=}5 的 Qwen3-0.6B 进行引导。 在数学、科学和编码智能体基准测试中，DoubtLess 在不改变任务表现的前提下，进一步将思考令牌数量减少了 29–52%（表 2）。 因此，DoubtLess 能够补充基于训练的压缩方法，并且无需进一步训练即可应用于已经压缩过的模型。

paragraphs.en: We measure end-to-end inference latency on a single B200 GPU, decoding one problem at a time on 14 problems, two from each of the seven benchmarks. DoubtLess takes 119.4 seconds per problem on average, compared with 156.2 seconds for plain decoding and 137.5 seconds for the concise prompt, reducing latency by 24% and 13%, respectively. The small model’s two forward passes of 0.6B parameters per step add about 4% to the FLOPs of the 32B model.

paragraphs.en: The random-target control tests whether the shortening comes from which tokens the small model pushes down or from perturbing the logits at all. At every step it keeps the adjustment values α ⁡ ( z brief − z verbose ) \alpha(z_{\mathrm{brief}}-z_{\mathrm{verbose}}) but assigns them to randomly chosen tokens of the top- p p set, so the size and scope of the change stay the same and only its direction is lost. With random targets, the thinking length stays within 8% of plain decoding on every benchmark and changes by 1% overall, against 31% for DoubtLess (Table 7 , Figure 10 ). The shortening therefore comes from the direction the small model supplies.

paragraphs.en: Methods that leave the model unchanged end the CoT once a budget is spent or the answer appears settled ( Muennighoff et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025b ; Song et al., 2026 ; Fu et al., 2024 ; Pu et al., 2025 ) , skip it ( Ma et al., 2025 ) , block the words that open another round of checking ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , or ask for brevity in the prompt ( Renze and Guven, 2024 ; Han et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) , which works only as far as the model follows the request ( Han et al., 2025 ; Aggarwal and Welleck, 2025 ) . Activation steering adds a fixed vector to the hidden states, taken from concise and verbose CoTs ( Azizi et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) or from execution and reflection steps ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , with a strength that can follow a signal read from the model ( Lin et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026b ) . Budget Guidance ( Li et al., 2026a ) reweights the next-token distribution with a trained length predictor. DoubtLess also reweights the next-token distribution, but its direction comes from an off-the-shelf small model, is recomputed from the context at every step and leaves the large model’s own logit for </think> untouched.
paragraphs.zh: 保持模型不变的方法会在预算耗尽或答案趋于稳定时终止 CoT（Muennighoff 等，2025；Yang 等，2025b；Song 等，2026；Fu 等，2024；Pu 等，2025），跳过 CoT（Ma 等，2025），阻止开启新一轮检查的词语（Wang 等，2025），或在提示中要求简洁表达（Renze 和 Guven，2024；Han 等，2025；Xu 等，2025），但这种方法仅在模型遵循该要求时有效（Han 等，2025；Aggarwal 和 Welleck，2025）。 激活引导通过向隐藏状态添加一个固定向量来发挥作用，该向量取自简洁或冗长的 CoT（Azizi 等，2026；Huang 等，2025），或来自执行与反思步骤（Chen 等，2025），其强度可依据从模型中读取的信号动态调整（Lin 等，2025；Li 等，2026b）。 预算引导（Li 等，2026a）使用一个经过训练的长度预测器对下一个词元的分布进行重新加权。 DoubtLess 同样会重新加权下一个词元的分布，但其方向来自一个现成的小型模型，并在每一步根据上下文重新计算，同时保持大型模型自身的 logits 不受影响。

paragraphs.en: Contrastive decoding scores the next token by the difference between an expert and a weaker amateur model ( Li et al., 2023 ; O’Brien and Lewis, 2023 ) , and DExperts and proxy-tuning steer a large model with small models that share only its vocabulary ( Liu et al., 2021 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) . (2026) contrast two prompts on the steered model itself. DoubtLess draws the contrast from an off-the-shelf small model under two instructions and uses it to shorten the CoT. paragraphs.en: DoubtLess adds the difference between a small reasoning model’s brief and verbose thinkers to a large reasoning model’s logits while it writes its CoT. On seven benchmarks it removes 31% of the thinking tokens of Qwen3-32B with unchanged accuracy, more than five inference-time baselines. It also shortens the CoT of a coding agent, and on two other model families it removes about three times as much as a concise prompt. Combined with training-based compression, it further shortens the CoT of a model already trained for brevity. Our analyses support the explanation that DoubtLess reduces redundant checking while retaining useful verification.
paragraphs.zh: DoubtLess 在大型推理模型生成 CoT 时，将其与小推理模型的简洁思维和冗长思维之间的差异添加到该模型的 logits 中。 在七项基准测试中，它在保持准确率不变的情况下，减少了 Qwen3-32B 31% 的思考标记，效果优于五种推理时的基线方法。 它还能缩短编码智能体的 CoT；在另外两个模型系列中，其减少的标记量约为简洁提示的三倍。 与基于训练的压缩方法结合使用时，它能进一步缩短已经针对简洁性进行训练过的模型的 CoT。 我们的分析支持这样一种解释：DoubtLess 在保留有用验证的同时，减少了冗余检查。

paragraphs.en: The contrast is added only while the large model writes its CoT, and the answer after </think> is decoded by the large model alone. Inside the CoT, the algorithm restores the large model’s own logits for </think> and the end-of-sequence token, so the CoT ends only where the large model itself would consider ending it. At such a point the contrast changes the competition. By lowering the tokens that open another round of checking, it lets the large model’s own </think> win more often. The mask is applied last, so the candidates are the top- p p set of the large model’s distribution at temperature one and the contrast never brings in a token outside it. The method has one hyperparameter, the strength α \alpha .

paragraphs.en: The large model runs in vLLM 0.29 ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) with tensor parallelism. We load the small model into the same vLLM model as the large one, so that a single request drives all three streams of Figure 2 . The small model keeps one copy of its linear weights but two copies of its attention layers, one for the brief thinker and one for the verbose thinker. The two thinkers go through the linear layers together, as a doubled batch, and through attention separately. Under tensor parallelism the small model is split across the GPUs by attention head, like the large model. The three streams differ only in the instruction sentence, which sits between the problem and the last few tokens of the chat template (Appendix B ). Everything else, the prompt, those template tokens and the generated tokens, uses the same slot mapping in the three streams’ paged KV caches, and we keep it in one paged key–value cache. The request’s block table is allocated for the large model’s sequence, and the small model’s attention layers, which have the same cache layout (eight key–value heads of dimension 128 in bfloat16, split across the GPUs), write their keys and values into the same blocks. vLLM then allocates, accounts for and frees the three streams as one, with no padding and no duplicated copies. The keys and values of the instruction sentence itself, at most 64 tokens per thinker, live in a small buffer per request that is allocated together with the model. The position IDs are those of each stream’s own sequence, so the thinkers see the template tokens and the generated tokens shifted by the length of their sentence. A key stores its own position, so the order of the blocks does not have to match the order of the positions. A thinker’s attention is computed in two parts, paged attention over the request’s blocks and dense attention over the instruction buffer, which are merged by their log-sum-exp (vLLM’s cascade-attention kernel does exactly this). The result is the attention over the full sequence. In the first step all three streams prefill the problem. The small model then reads its two instruction sentences against the cached problem and fills the buffer, after which decoding proceeds with every sampled token fed to all three streams. The forward pass returns the three hidden states.
paragraphs.zh: 大模型在 vLLM 0.29（Kwon 等人，2023）中运行，并采用张量并行。 我们将小模型加载到与大模型相同的 vLLM 模型中，这样单个请求即可驱动图 2 中的所有三个流。 小模型保留一份线性权重的副本，但注意力层则保留两份副本：一份用于简短思考者，另一份用于冗长思考者。 两个思考者共同通过线性层（作为双倍批处理），但分别通过注意力层。 在张量并行下，小模型与大型模型一样，按注意力头划分到不同的 GPU 上。 三个流仅在指令句子上有所不同，该句子位于问题与聊天模板的最后几个 token 之间（附录 B）。 其余所有内容——提示词、模板 token 和生成的 token——在三个流的分页 KV 缓存中均使用相同的槽位映射，并且我们将其保留在单个分页键值缓存中。 请求的块表为大型模型的序列分配空间，而小模型的注意力层（其缓存布局相同：bfloat16 格式下维度为 128 的八个键值头，分布在 GPU 上）则将其键和值写入相同的块。随后，vLLM 将三个流作为一个整体进行分配、计费和释放，无需填充或重复复制。 指令句子本身的键和值（每个思考者最多 64 个 token）存储在每个请求的小型缓冲区中，该缓冲区与模型一同分配。 位置 ID 对应于每个流自身的序列，因此思考者看到模板 token 和生成的 token 会因各自句子的长度而发生偏移。 键本身存储其位置信息，因此块的顺序不必与位置顺序一致。 思考者的注意力计算分为两部分：对请求块的分页注意力以及对指令缓冲区的密集注意力，这两部分通过 log-sum-exp 合并（vLLM 的级联注意力内核正是如此实现的）。 最终得到的是对整个序列的注意力结果。 在第一步中，所有三个流都对问题进行预填充。 随后，小模型读取其两个指令句子与缓存的问题，并填充缓冲区；之后，每次采样出的 token 都会被送入所有三个流以继续解码。 前向传播返回三个隐藏状态。

paragraphs.en: The published version of ASC learns the steering vector by gradient descent, which requires an additional training run. We follow the training-free version in the authors’ released code, which adds the mean of the last-token differences between verbose and concise CoTs, scaled by a strength, to the output of one decoder layer at every forward pass, so at every generated token and at the last prompt token. The calibration set is the first 100 problems of MATH-500 in an order that cycles through its subjects. For each, Qwen3-32B writes one CoT under its plain instruction and one under the brief thinker’s sentence, with the sampling settings of Appendix E and a 16,384-token budget, and both are read back after the plain instruction. paragraphs.en: The agent solves each of the 164 HumanEval+ problems ( Liu et al., 2023 ) in at most two turns. In the first turn the model receives the function to complete with the instruction “Complete this Python function. Return the FULL function in one python block”, thinks, and writes the program. The program is run against the HumanEval+ tests. If it fails, the model receives the test’s error message with the instruction “Your program failed the tests with this error: … Fix the program. Return the FULL function in one python block” and gets one more turn. Every turn has its own CoT with a budget of 4,096 tokens and 1,024 tokens for the program. DoubtLess is applied inside each CoT exactly as in the single-turn runs, with the same two thinker sentences appended to the last user message, NoWait blocks the same 89 token ids, the concise prompt appends the brief sentence to the last user message, and the random-target control is applied as in the single-turn runs. DEER and ThinkBrake run inside each turn as it is decoded, since an early exit in the first turn changes the program that the repair turn sees. DEER uses the code inducer and 1,024-token trials of LiveCodeBench (Appendix D ) and cuts the CoT at 0.8 × 0.8\times the turn’s thinking budget. ThinkBrake first decodes the turn as plain decoding with the same seed, reads its rule at the sentence boundaries of that CoT as in the single-turn runs, and closes the CoT at the first boundary where it fires, followed by a freshly sampled program. Under plain decoding 16–20% of the turns reach the budget of 4,096 thinking tokens without closing their CoT and so write no program. DoubtLess halves the number of such turns, and DEER’s cut leaves none. The random-target control leaves the thinking per turn within 1% of plain decoding and the pass rate within 1.2 points. Three seeds per problem. The pass rate counts a problem as solved if the program passes all tests after the first or the second turn, averaged over seeds, and thinking tokens are averaged over turns and seeds.
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体最多在两轮内解决 HumanEval+ 的 164 个问题（Liu 等人，2023）。第一轮中，模型接收到需要完成的函数以及指令“完成这个 Python 函数。以单个 Python 代码块返回完整函数”，然后进行思考并编写程序。随后，该程序会在 HumanEval+ 测试集上运行。如果程序失败，模型会收到测试的错误信息以及指令“你的程序在测试中失败，错误如下：……请修复程序。以单个 Python 代码块返回完整函数”，并获得一轮额外的尝试机会。每一轮都有独立的 CoT，其思考预算为 4,096 个词元，程序预算为 1,024 个词元。DoubtLess 在每一轮 CoT 中的使用方式与单轮运行完全相同：将相同的两个思考句子附加到最后一个用户消息中；NoWait 阻止相同的 89 个词元 ID；简洁提示则将简短句子附加到最后一个用户消息中；随机目标控制也按单轮运行的方式应用。DEER 和 ThinkBrake 在每一轮解码过程中实时运行，因为第一轮提前退出会改变修复轮所看到的程序。DEER 使用代码诱导器和 LiveCodeBench 的 1,024 词元测试用例（附录 D），并在 CoT 达到该轮思考预算的 0.8 × 0.8 倍时将其截断。ThinkBrake 首先以相同种子进行普通解码，然后像单轮运行一样，在该 CoT 的句子边界处读取其规则，并在规则首次触发时关闭 CoT，随后生成一个全新采样的程序。在普通解码中，16%–20% 的轮次会达到 4,096 个思考词元的预算而未能结束 CoT，因此没有写出任何程序。DoubtLess 将此类轮次的数量减少一半，而 DEER 的截断机制则完全消除了这种情况。随机目标控制使每轮的思考词元数与普通解码的差异保持在 1% 以内，通过率差异则在 1.2 个百分点以内。每个问题使用三个种子。如果程序在第一轮或第二轮后通过所有测试，则该问题被视为已解决，并在不同种子之间取平均；思考词元则在不同轮次和种子之间取平均。
